connect.title: Ceangley LinkedIn
connect.intro: Sign in rish y cuntoirt LinkedIn ta stiurey dty ads. Leadrat t'eh ry-lesh ny cunteynyn ad, Lead Gen Form leads as statistickyn ad, as t'eh cur stiagh ymmyd jeh'n aght t'ou uss ry-chur stiagh.
connect.need1: Rol er y cuntoirt ad LinkedIn (Viewer ny s'yrjey).
connect.need2: Rol er duillag y chompaney ceaghlit (Ree, Lead Gen Forms Manager , Content Admin , Curator ny Analyst) - Ta LinkedIn goaill rish dy row eh ry-cheilley.
connect.need3: Question lhum phone er ny Lead Gen Forms - cha nel leadsyn gyn lhum phone ry-chur rish.

capi.intro: Insh da LinkedIn c'raad jeh e stiureyderyn v'er jeet dy ve glen-chreeagh. Ta'n ID lead LinkedIn as hash un-raad jeh'n e-mail er ny choyrt.
